component.name: MainScene
component.script:
sub init() m.n = 0 m.task = createObject("roSGNode", "WorkerTask") m.task.observeField("ready", "onReady") m.task.observeField("report", "onReport") m.task.control = "run" m.timer = createObject("roSGNode", "Timer") m.timer.duration = 0.05 m.timer.repeat = true m.timer.observeField("fire", "onFire") end sub
' Writes start only after the task has launched. sub onReady() m.timer.control = "start" end sub
sub onFire() m.n++ m.task.cmd = m.n if m.n >= 10 then m.timer.control = "stop" end sub
sub onReport(event as object) print "TASK SAW: "; event.getData() m.top.done = true end sub
